[[Bone Dragon]]s are found throughout the [[Kryta]] region in the [[Prophecies]] campaign. Bone Dragons as we see them are only half of their original bodies, the lower half having torn off due to the pure strength of the Bone Dragons' forearms when they were risen from their graves.<ref>[http://www.ign.com/articles/2004/10/13/the-armies-of-guild-wars-the-undead The Armies of Guild Wars - The Undead], IGN.com</ref>
